description: Auto-approve a payment for ecosystem services only when the contract and the monitoring report refer to the same contract, the contract is valid on the evaluation date, the monitoring was observed within the contract validity and not after the evaluation date, the verified area is at least the committed area, and the amount is within the automated actor's autonomy limit; otherwise escalate to the human approver with one reason per failed condition, in the order listed.
dates: calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD; comparisons are inclusive
areas: square metres as canonical decimal strings

conditions.check: each required document kind is submitted exactly once

conditions.reason: contract number differs between contract and monitoring report
ecosystem services contract not yet valid | ecosystem services contract expired

conditions.check: pes_contract.valid_from <= monitoring_report.observed_on <= pes_contract.valid_until and monitoring_report.observed_on <= evaluation_date
conditions.reason: monitoring observed outside the contract validity | monitoring observed after the evaluation date

notEvaluated: a condition that reads a missing or duplicated document is not evaluated
